name: oomol
description: OOMOL: the oo CLI for the apps connected in OOMOL (mail, calendar, documents) and its hosted capabilities, run with the user's key.

OO_API_KEY.title: API key
OO_API_KEY.description: Generated on [OOMOL's MCP page](https://oomol.com/install/mcp/); replace it here when OOMOL resets it.

OO_TEAM_NAME.description: The team in OOMOL: the `x-oo-team-name` of the configuration shown there.
